newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 9-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 9-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of nine-day fixed-system repurchase agreements on Tuesday.

Analysts said another intervention was possible Tuesday as high tax revenues were pushing up the Fed's need to add reserves. The Fed has conducted mutiple-day operations in the past few sessions, including adding permanent reserves via a coupon pass on Monday.
Fed funds were trading at 5.56 percent, slightly above the Fed's current official target level of 5.50 percent.
